title: kioku.tool.v1 common request envelope
description: The envelope every tool call carries. Two variants: a read envelope and a mutation envelope, which differ only in what is required. Both are closed, so an identity or authority field has nowhere to land at any depth.

read.title: read envelope
read.description: Reads carry no idempotency fields. Supplying one is refused with kioku.invalid_request: an idempotency receipt is a durability claim, a read produces none, and accepting the field would invite a caller to believe a read had been deduplicated.

mutation.title: mutation envelope
mutation.description: Mutations additionally carry an actor-scoped idempotency key and a request digest, plus expected_revision when appending to an existing record. Same key with the same recomputed digest returns the prior receipt verbatim; same key with a different digest returns kioku.idempotency_conflict.

x-kioku-validation-order-note: Fields are validated in this order so an unsupported schema version is reported before any scope resolution, which is what lets kioku.unsupported_schema_version answer with a null generation vector honestly.
